content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define pollination and distinguish it from fertilisation
Describe the growth of the pollen tube
Explain the process of fertilisation in plants
is the transfer of pollen from anther to stigma.
is the fusion of male and female gamete nuclei. These are two separate processes, and both must occur for seeds to develop.
Pollination must occur before fertilisation can happen.
Generative nucleus follows (or divides into two male gametes)

Pollination = pollen transfer; fertilisation = nuclear fusion

Transfer of pollen from anther to stigma

Opening in ovule for pollen tube entry
